name: airlock-terminal
description: Chat-to-terminal airlock: a web chat and a real terminal in one window, with a scratchpad between them.

extendInfo.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Airlock Terminal runs your shell. Commands you run in it, such as ping, ssh and curl, may need to reach devices on your local network.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: For voice mode in the Claude chat, and for commands you run in the terminal that record audio.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: For commands you run in the terminal that record audio.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: For commands you run in the terminal that use the camera.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Commands and scripts you run in the terminal, such as osascript, may control other apps.
extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: Commands you run in the terminal may read or change files on your Desktop.
extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Commands you run in the terminal may read or change files in your Documents folder.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: Commands you run in the terminal may read or change files in your Downloads folder, and downloads from the chat may be saved there.
extendInfo.NSRemovableVolumesUsageDescription: Commands you run in the terminal may read or change files on external drives.
extendInfo.NSNetworkVolumesUsageDescription: Commands you run in the terminal may read or change files on network drives.
extendInfo.NSFileProviderDomainUsageDescription: Commands you run in the terminal may read or change files in iCloud Drive and other cloud folders.
extendInfo.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: For commands you run in the terminal that use Bluetooth.
extendInfo.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: For commands you run in the terminal that use Bluetooth.
